856-2511-5776-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2105-5144-7060-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5144-7060-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5144-7060-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

728-6517-7084.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

240-3899-5470-6633.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

240-647-3899-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

1981-2415-2921-7399.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2921-7399.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

277-851-4365-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1987-2020-3227.easyPrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
Vadrik has at least 2 power.
1987-2020-3227.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Scrivener.
When Scrivener enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2020-3227.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1409-2079-3099-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

628-5007-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.
628-5007-5256.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

3532-5078-5402-7356.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-7356.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

719-1486-5433--119.easyPrerequisites: You control an untapped creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
719-1486-5433--119.description:
Tap a creature using any method.
Magda triggers, as the creature is a Dwarf due to Xenograft, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Krenko triggers, causing you to pay {R} to create a 1/1 Goblin creature token and giving it haste until end of turn.
Repeat, tapping the Goblin instead.
719-1486-5433--119.notes: The method used to tap creatures must be usable for all creatures you control for the loop to continue. You may use Krenko (or Magda if it doesn't have summoning sickness) to start the combo if they're untapped. Some methods may overt the summoning sickness requirement (like Earthcraft, for example).

30-141-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-141-5256.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-141-5256.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-3129-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-3129-4772.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

224-280-1772-5478.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

394-1445-2292-4871.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
394-1445-2292-4871.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Desecrated Tomb triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

855-1491-6006-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
855-1491-6006-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
855-1491-6006-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1621-4264.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Altered Ego.
1621-4264.description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Altered Ego enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Altered Ego. Choose to have Altered Ego enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-2645-4131-4734.notablePrerequisites: Cradle Clearcutter does not have summoning sickness and has power 5 or greater.
1651-2645-4131-4734.description:
Activate Cradle Clearcutter by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Staff of Domination and Basalt Monolith, untapping Cradle Clearcutter.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities and/or untap any artifact(s) you control.

656-1012-5220.description:
Cast Ugin's Conjurant either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Ugin's Conjurant enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Ugin's Conjurant on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

215-579-4541.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Treasures.
215-579-4541.description:
Activate four Treasures you control by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}.
Cast Marut by paying {8}.
Marut enters the battlefield, creating eight Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Marut from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1761-4551.description:
Phyrexian Unlife prevents you from losing the game due to having 0 life.
Delaying Shield prevents you from taking infect damage due to Phyrexian Unlife.
